nodes.question: What do the variables Qt and Qe represent in the equations provided?
nodes.answer: Qt represents the adsorbed amount of heavy metals at time t, and Qe represents the adsorbed amount at adsorption equilibrium.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Waterborne diseases prevention|Contaminant removal strategies_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What were the removal percentages of Pb(II) using REEs/C prepared at different temperatures?
nodes.answer: The removal percentages of Pb(II) were 85.1% for REEs/C prepared at 400 °C, 84.0% for REEs/C prepared at 800 °C, and 67.0% for REEs/C prepared at 600 °C.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Waterborne diseases prevention|Contaminant removal strategies_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What functional groups were confirmed in the REEs/C-4 that contributed to its effectiveness in Pb(II) removal?
nodes.answer: Rich functional groups such as aromatic, hydroxyl, and C = C/C-C were confirmed in REEs/C-4, providing more chelation sites for complexing with Pb(II).
